settings.title: Bitbucket Integration
settings.description: Connect a Bitbucket Cloud repository for its issues, pull requests and pipelines
settings.enableDescription: Show this repository's issues and pull requests, and open a task's pull request on Bitbucket.
settings.usernameDescription: With an API token or an app password, the account's email or username. Leave it empty for a repository or workspace access token.
settings.tokenDescription: An API token, an app password or an access token with read access to issues, pull requests and pipelines, and write access to pull requests to open them. It is stored encrypted.
settings.repoDescription: Filled from the project's bitbucket.org remote when empty. You can also paste workspace/repository or a clone URL.
settings.checkUsesSaved: The test uses the saved settings.
settings.autoSync: Load issues when the project opens
settings.autoSyncDescription: Fetch the Bitbucket issues as soon as the project is opened.
